name: PostgreSQL Connection
description: A named PostgreSQL connection a db.pg task refers to by name. It is given only to the method whose task names it, never to a device or an environment. The host is the server as the device a task runs on sees it.

fields.label: Connection name
fields.help_text: What a task calls this connection (connection: appdb). Several connections may be bound to one template, each with its own name.

fields.label: Host
fields.help_text: The server as the device a task runs on sees it: a name, an address, or its Unix socket directory.

fields.label: Password
fields.help_text: Leave empty for peer or trust authentication.

fields.label: TLS
fields.help_text: verify-full checks the server's certificate against the pinned CA or the system's roots; disable is for a local server (loopback or a socket).

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help_text: The PEM authority the server's certificate must chain to. Empty means the system's roots.

fields.label: Server name
fields.help_text: The name the certificate is checked against, when it is not the host.

fields.label: Allow plaintext across a network
fields.help_text: Allows TLS disable to a server that is not local. The password and every row then cross that network in the clear, and every run warns.

fields.label: Live databases
fields.help_text: Comma-separated databases on this server a restore refuses unless the task overrides it and says why.
